source: A immunology and microbiology bibliography in Chicago author-date style, built for this suite from records checked against Crossref and DataCite on 2026-10-03; errors planted by hand. Invented DOIs checked unregistered at doi.org, and closed_real papers checked closed in OpenAlex, the same day.
